game.title: Borderlands Game of the Year Enhanced

roadmap.title: Arid Badlands to Sledge
roadmap.description: Play the opening story through Fyrestone, Skag Gully and Headstone Mine, finishing the early side missions, vehicle kills, first artifact and action-skill kills.

roadmap.title: Dahl Headland and the first Rust Commons areas
roadmap.description: Do the speed lap, the proficiency and level 20 milestones, and the Corrosive and Incendiary kills while working through New Haven and Earl's Scrapyard.

roadmap.title: Krom, Trash Coast and the Vault keys
roadmap.description: Beat Krom, the Rakk Hive and Flynt, enter the new areas, and pick up the hidden ship and money total.

roadmap.title: Crimson Fastness to the Vault
roadmap.description: Rescue the last Claptraps, enter the Crimson Enclave and Eridian Promontory, and kill the Destroyer to finish the first playthrough.

roadmap.title: Second playthrough levels
roadmap.description: Start the second playthrough and reach levels 40, 50 and 51.

roadmap.title: The Secret Armory of General Knoxx
roadmap.description: Play the Knoxx DLC story, find the loot midgets and reach level 61.

roadmap.title: The Zombie Island of Dr. Ned
roadmap.description: Finish the Ned story missions and bosses, then collect Brains for the final mission.

roadmap.title: Claptrap's New Robot Revolution
roadmap.description: Finish the Claptrap story, read the six statue placards and farm the rare Claptrap drops.

roadmap.title: Mad Moxxi's Underdome Riot
roadmap.description: Beat the first tournament, then the three 20-round large challenges with one character.

roadmap.title: Crawmerax and Completionist
roadmap.description: Kill Crawmerax and finish every Secret Armory mission.

roadmap.title: Online co-op session
roadmap.description: Play with another player for the duel, arena, revive, co-op mission, co-op boss and viral achievements.

achievements.description: Completed 5 missions in the Arid Badlands
achievements.summary: Finish 5 missions in the Arid Badlands.

steps.text: Turn in any 5 main or side missions in the @loc{Arid Badlands}, starting with the ones in Fyrestone.

achievements.description: Completed all missions in the Arid Badlands
achievements.summary: Finish every mission (42 in total) in the Arid Badlands.

guide.context: Side missions never expire, so you can finish any you skipped before you leave the area.

steps.text: Finish all 20 main missions and 22 side missions in the @loc{Arid Badlands}.
Turn in the last side mission to unlock the achievement.

achievements.description: Completed 5 missions in the Rust Commons
achievements.summary: Finish 5 missions in the Rust Commons.

steps.text: Turn in any 5 main or side missions in the @loc{Rust Commons}, starting in New Haven.

achievements.description: Completed all missions in the Rust Commons
achievements.summary: Finish every mission in the Rust Commons.

guide.context: No mission can be missed. The achievement can unlock before the last few story missions are done.

steps.text: Finish every main and side mission from the Dahl Headland through the Crimson Fastness (79 in total).
If the achievement has not unlocked after you complete the story mission "Find the Echo Command Console", finish the missions you skipped.

achievements.displayName: My Brother is an Italian Plumber
achievements.summary: Kill an enemy by landing on its head with a jump.

steps.text: Find a Level 2 @enemy{Pup Skag} with no other enemies near it.
Shoot it until it has very little health left.
Jump and land on it to finish it. The landing must hit the Pup Skag.

achievements.summary: Complete the 12 Days of Pandora challenge.

guide.context: You need a source of corrosive damage, such as a Corrosive weapon or artifact.

steps.text: Make these kills: 12 with a Combat Rifle, 11 with a Pistol, 10 with a Shotgun, 9 with an SMG and 8 with a Sniper Rifle.
Make these kills: 7 by melee, 6 critical hits, 5 with explosives, 4 with shock, 3 with incendiary, 2 with corrosive and 1 with a grenade.
Check your progress in the Challenges tab.

achievements.summary: Kill the boss Sledge in Headstone Mine.

steps.text: Take the elevator up to Sledge's lair in @loc{Headstone Mine} during the mission "Sledge: Battle For The Badlands".
Break @enemy{Sledge}'s shield, then lure him back toward the room with the shops.
When he stands outside a door, open it, shoot him, then back away and hide while your shield and health recharge. Repeat until he dies.

achievements.summary: Kill the boss Krom in Krom's Canyon.

steps.text: Cross the walkways in @loc{Krom's Canyon} and dodge the Gatling Turret.
Shoot the turret down from behind cover once you are close. Sniping it from far away takes too long.
Kill @enemy{Krom} to get the second Vault Key Piece.

achievements.summary: Kill the boss Baron Flynt.

steps.text: Kill @enemy{Hanz} and @enemy{Franz} first.
Go to the top of Thor and kill @enemy{Baron Flynt} to get the final Vault Key Piece.

achievements.summary: Kill the Rakk Hive in the Trash Coast.

steps.text: In the @loc{Trash Coast}, follow the loud roar you hear to find the @enemy{Rakk Hive}, during the mission "Another Piece of the Puzzle".
Shoot the critical points on its eyes until it dies.

achievements.summary: Kill the Destroyer, the boss of the Vault.

steps.text: Enter the Vault during the mission "Find Steele" and fight the @enemy{Destroyer}.
Shoot the weak points on its tentacles and the large blue eye.
The Vault has no shops. The purple tentacles can resupply ammo, so fight carefully.

achievements.description: Raced around the Ludicrous Speedway in record time
achievements.summary: Race around the Ludicrous Speedway in under 31 seconds.

steps.text: In the Dahl Headland, start the side mission "Death Race Pandora" and clear the Scythids on the track.
Drive back to the track entrance and stop on the other side of the flagged arch at the entrance.
Drive one full lap and come back out to this same spot in under 31 seconds. You can retry as often as you need.

achievements.summary: Equip an elemental artifact.

steps.text: In the @loc{Lost Cave}, destroy the crystal clusters to collect 50 Shock Crystals for the side mission "Shock Crystal Harvest".
The Alpha Skags in the cave are tough. Come back around Level 13 or 14 if they give you trouble.
Turn in the mission at the Fyrestone Bounty Board to get the Shock Artifact.
Equip the artifact.

achievements.summary: Reach level 5.

steps.text: Earn XP from kills, missions and challenges until you reach level 5.

achievements.summary: Reach level 10.

steps.text: Earn XP from kills, missions and challenges until you reach level 10.

achievements.summary: Reach level 20.

steps.text: Earn XP from kills, missions and challenges until you reach level 20.

achievements.summary: Reach level 30.

steps.text: Earn XP from kills, missions and challenges until you reach level 30.

achievements.summary: Reach level 40.

guide.context: The second playthrough starts around level 34 to 36, so level 40 comes quickly there.

steps.text: Earn XP from kills and missions until you reach level 40.

achievements.summary: Enter Skag Gully for the first time.

steps.text: During the mission "Nine-Toes: Take Him Down", blow up the barricade and enter @loc{Skag Gully}.

achievements.summary: Enter Sledge's Safe House for the first time.

steps.text: During the mission "Sledge: The Mine Key", enter @loc{Sledge's Safe House} to get the Mine Gate Key.

achievements.summary: Enter Headstone Mine for the first time.

steps.text: Enter @loc{Headstone Mine} on your way to the mission "Sledge: Battle For The Badlands".

achievements.summary: Go into the Trash Coast area for the first time.

steps.text: After the mission "Jaynistown: Cleaning Up Your Mess", go past where you spoke with @npc{Taylor Kobb} and find his Claptrap.
Use it to open the way, then enter the @loc{Trash Coast}.

achievements.summary: Enter Earl's Scrapyard for the first time.

steps.text: Enter @loc{Earl's Scrapyard} in the Rust Commons. The mission "Meet 'Crazy' Earl" also sends you there.

achievements.summary: Enter Krom's Canyon for the first time.

steps.text: During the mission "The Next Piece", fight through the Bandits at the dam to the transition and enter @loc{Krom's Canyon}.

achievements.summary: Enter the Crimson Lance Enclave for the first time.

steps.text: Leave the @loc{Crimson Fastness} and go outside into the @loc{Crimson Enclave}.

achievements.summary: Enter the Eridian Promontory for the first time.

steps.text: Fight through the @loc{Descent} to reach the @loc{Eridian Promontory}, the area before the Vault.

achievements.summary: Reach level 50.

guide.context: On the second playthrough you reach level 50 around Jaynistown in Rust Commons East if you do the side missions.

steps.text: Earn XP from kills and missions until you reach level 50.

achievements.displayName: Get A Little Blood on the Tires
achievements.description: Killed 25 enemies by ramming them with any vehicle
achievements.summary: Kill 25 enemies by running them over with any vehicle.

steps.text: Complete the mission "Bone Head's Theft" so you can summon a vehicle.
Drive around the @loc{Arid Badlands} and run over 25 Bandits or Skags.

achievements.summary: Kill 5 Rakk within 10 seconds.

steps.text: In @loc{Skag Gully}, go near the dormant Rakk hives. 5 to 8 Rakk fly out.
Shoot them as they first fly at you, with a quick-firing gun (Combat Rifle, Repeater Pistol or SMG) or your action skill.

achievements.summary: Earn $1,000,000 in total.

steps.text: Keep selling loot and finishing missions. The total adds up over time, so you do not need to hold $1,000,000 at once.

achievements.summary: Sell 50 guns to a shop.

steps.text: Sell the guns you no longer need to a shop until you have sold 50 in total.

achievements.description: Emerged victorious from an arena match
achievements.summary: Win an arena match against another player in co-op.

guide.context: The Fyrestone Coliseum is in the Bandit camp you visit during the mission "Blinding Nine-Toes".

steps.text: Start an online co-op game with another player.
Go to an arena: the @loc{Fyrestone Coliseum} in the Arid Badlands, @loc{The Cesspool} in Rust Commons West, or @loc{Devil's Footstool} in the Salt Flats.
Enter an arena match against each other and win it.

achievements.description: Won a duel against another player
achievements.summary: Win a duel against another player.

steps.text: In an online co-op game, open the game options and switch Duel Request to Accept.
Melee the other player. If they melee you back, a duel starts.
Win the duel. The other player can let you kill them.

achievements.description: Rescued a groupmate from death in a co-op game
achievements.summary: Revive a downed teammate in a co-op game.

steps.text: Let an enemy bring the other player's health to zero so they enter Fight For Your Life.
Kill the enemies near them, then hold the use button to revive them.

achievements.summary: Complete 15 missions in co-op.

steps.text: Play together and complete 15 missions. Main and side missions both count.
The fastest way is to play only main missions up to killing Sledge.

achievements.description: Defeated a story boss in a co-op game.
achievements.summary: Defeat Sledge, Krom, Flynt, the Rakk Hive or the Destroyer in a co-op game.

steps.text: Play the story with another player in your game.
Kill any one of those bosses together. The first chance is Sledge during the mission "Sledge: Battle For The Badlands".

achievements.description: Play with at least two other players.
achievements.summary: Play in an online co-op game with at least two other players.

guide.context: You do not need a partner who already has the achievement.

steps.text: Start or join an online co-op game that has at least two other players in it.
If you need players, invite friends. Everyone in the game can earn it.

achievements.description: Reached proficiency level 10 with any weapon type
achievements.summary: Raise one weapon type to proficiency level 10.

steps.text: Pick one weapon type and use it as your main weapon. Weapon proficiency rises with any XP you earn while holding that weapon, not only kills.

achievements.description: Reach the hidden ship in Treacher's Landing.
achievements.summary: Step onto the hidden ship at the end of the dock in Treacher's Landing.

steps.text: In @loc{Treacher's Landing}, find the single dock on the far southeastern edge of the map.
Walk around the large cliff face beside the water to find a hidden path to the dock.
Step onto the ship at the end of the dock.

achievements.description: Won a duel without taking damage
achievements.summary: Win a duel without taking any damage.

steps.text: Set up a duel as for Duel-icious: Duel Request set to Accept, then melee the other player.
Ask the other player not to attack you, then kill them.

achievements.summary: Kill 25 enemies with corrosive weapons.

steps.text: Kill 25 enemies with corrosive weapons. Kills from a Corrosive artifact on your action skill also count.

achievements.summary: Kill 25 enemies with shock weapons.

steps.text: Kill 25 enemies with shock weapons. Kills from a Shock artifact on your action skill and from Shock Barrels also count.

achievements.summary: Kill 25 enemies with incendiary weapons.

guide.context: You get the first Incendiary artifact by killing Moe and Marley in the Arid Badlands.

steps.text: Kill 25 enemies with incendiary weapons. Kills from an Incendiary artifact, Incendiary Barrels and grenades also count.

achievements.summary: Kill 25 enemies with explosive weapons.

steps.text: Kill 25 enemies with explosive weapons. A vehicle's Rocket Launcher turret counts, which makes a Rocket Launcher Runner an easy way to get them.

achievements.displayName: There are some who call me...Tim
achievements.description: Equipped a class mod for your character
achievements.summary: Equip a class mod on your character.

steps.text: Finish the mission "Sledge: Battle For The Badlands", then equip the class mod you receive.

achievements.description: Rescued enough Claptraps to earn 42 inventory slots
achievements.summary: Rescue Claptraps to earn 42 inventory slots.

guide.context: Each of the 10 base-game rescues gives a Backpack SDU. Equip every one of them. Listening for the Claptrap's cry helps you find it.

collectibles.name: Safe House Claptrap
collectibles.location: @loc{Sledge's Safe House}, dead end to the right at the T-junction
collectibles.method: Talk to the Claptrap, find the Repair Kit back along the waypoint, and bring it back.
collectibles.note: Mission: Claptrap Rescue: Safe House. Pass three rooms, go up the rubble ramp, then down the stairs.

collectibles.name: Lost Cave Claptrap
collectibles.location: @loc{Lost Cave}, middle of the Bandit hideout in the second half
collectibles.method: Find the Repair Kit near the end of the area and bring it back.
collectibles.note: Mission: Claptrap Rescue: The Lost Cave.

collectibles.name: New Haven Claptrap
collectibles.location: @loc{New Haven}, right beside the Bounty Board
collectibles.method: Climb onto the marked roof, reach through the balcony rails for the Repair Kit, then bring it back.

collectibles.name: Tetanus Warren Claptrap
collectibles.location: @loc{Tetanus Warren}, entrance of the dead-end Bandit hideout on the westmost path
collectibles.method: Find the Repair Kit further into the area and bring it back.
collectibles.note: Mission: Claptrap Rescue: Tetanus Warren. The path comes after your second Spiderant fight.

collectibles.name: Scrapyard Claptrap
collectibles.location: @loc{Earl's Scrapyard}, Northeastern Bandit hideout, under the red canvas between two huts
collectibles.method: Find the Repair Kit at the far end of the area and bring it back.

collectibles.name: Krom's Canyon Claptrap
collectibles.location: @loc{Krom's Canyon}, near the scrap bridge with a Checkpoint
collectibles.method: Jump from the roof of the hut next to the scrap tower to grab the Repair Kit hanging on the rope, then bring it back.
collectibles.note: Mission: Claptrap Rescue: Krom's Canyon. It is just before the bridge, after the 4th Canned Skag Meat.

collectibles.name: Trash Coast Claptrap
collectibles.location: @loc{Trash Coast}, southwest of the big Bandit camp, between a hut and a grey container
collectibles.method: Climb onto the pipeline to get the Repair Kit, then bring it back.
collectibles.note: Mission: Claptrap Rescue: Trash Coast. The Repair Kit marker is on top of the pipeline.

collectibles.name: Old Haven Claptrap
collectibles.location: @loc{Old Haven}, west end of the pier, under a sign showing a crate with a dollar sign
collectibles.method: Find the Repair Kit and bring it back.
collectibles.note: Mission: Claptrap Rescue: Old Haven. This Claptrap only appears after the main mission that frees Tannis' Claptrap.

collectibles.name: Salt Flats Claptrap
collectibles.location: @loc{Salt Flats}, hut with a green roof
collectibles.method: Collect the nearby Repair Kit and bring it back.
collectibles.note: Mission: Claptrap Rescue: The Salt Flats.

collectibles.name: Crimson Fastness Claptrap
collectibles.location: @loc{Crimson Fastness}, in front of the Gatling Turret at the end of the long hallway
collectibles.method: Destroy the turret first. The Repair Kit is in the room directly east, on the lower level of the garage.

achievements.description: Killed an enemy with the Siren's action skill
achievements.summary: Get a kill with the Siren's action skill.

steps.text: Play as @npc{Lilith} and reach level 5 to unlock her action skill, Phasewalk.
Shoot an enemy until it is nearly dead, then use Phasewalk to finish it.

achievements.description: Killed 15 enemies with the Hunter's action skill
achievements.summary: Get 15 kills with the Hunter's action skill.

guide.context: Bloodwing is weak, so this is the slowest of the four action-skill achievements. Each class needs its own character, and level 5 comes quickly in a fresh game.

steps.text: Play as @npc{Mordecai} and reach level 5 to unlock his action skill, Bloodwing.
Shoot an enemy until it is nearly dead, then send Bloodwing to finish it.
Run away while the skill recharges, then repeat until you have 15 kills.

achievements.description: Killed 15 enemies with the Berserker's action skill
achievements.summary: Get 15 kills with the Berserker's action skill.

steps.text: Play as @npc{Brick} and reach level 5 to unlock his action skill, Berserk.
Find a group of enemies, use Berserk and punch as many as you can.
Run away while the skill recharges, then repeat until you have 15 kills.

achievements.description: Killed 15 enemies with the Soldier's action skill
achievements.summary: Get 15 kills with the Soldier's action skill.

steps.text: Play as @npc{Roland} and reach level 5 to unlock his action skill, the Scorpio Turret.
Pull a large group of Skags toward you and drop the turret so it kills them.
Wait for the skill to recharge, then repeat until you have 15 kills.

achievements.description: Completed the "House of the Ned" mission
achievements.summary: Complete the "House of the Ned" mission.

steps.text: Follow the main missions of The Zombie Island of Dr. Ned to Dr. Ned's lair and meet him to complete the mission.

achievements.summary: Complete the "Jakobs Fodder" mission.

steps.text: Keep going through the main missions, then deliver the evidence against Dr. Ned to Jakobs Corp in @loc{Dead Haven} to complete the mission.

achievements.summary: Defeat Dr. Ned in the first boss fight in the Mill.

steps.text: Go to the @loc{Mill} in the Lumber Yard during the mission "Night of the Living Ned" and defeat @enemy{Dr. Ned}.

achievements.summary: Defeat Undead Ned after the Dr. Ned fight.

steps.text: After Dr. Ned falls, he turns into the final boss.
Drop into the charnel pit after him and kill @enemy{Undead Ned}.

achievements.summary: Complete the "Braaaaaaaaaaaaains!" mission by turning in 250 Brains.

guide.context: The "Braaaaaaaaaaaaains!" mission is the last in the chain. Do not run away right after a turn-in: the zombie eats the Brains and may spit out loot.

steps.text: In @loc{Hallow's End}, go to the far southwest corner of the map. Follow the signs to the cemetery town and enter the Fyrestone home.
Talk to the friendly @npc{Zombie} to start the Brains missions.
Turn in Brains for each mission in turn: 10, 25, 50, 100 and then 250. Each turn-in gives you the next mission.
Collect Brains by killing zombies with headshots. Generally Hospital and the Lumber Yard have many zombies.

achievements.description: Completed the lesser challenge in all 3 coliseums
achievements.summary: Finish the lesser challenge in all three Underdome coliseums.

guide.context: Completing this mission also unlocks the large challenges.

steps.text: Go to the @loc{Underdome} and take the mission "Prove Yourself".
Beat 5 rounds in each of the Hell-Burbia, The Angelic Ruins and The Gully coliseums. Each round has 5 waves.
Turn in the mission.

achievements.description: Completed the larger challenge in the Hell-Burbia coliseum
achievements.summary: Finish all 20 rounds of the large Hell-Burbia challenge.

guide.context: Each large challenge takes about 2.5 to 5 hours. Enemy level follows the game's host, so playing a high-level character in the game of a low-level host (level 20 or below) makes it far easier.

steps.text: Finish the mission "Prove Yourself" first so the large challenges appear.
Enter the large Hell-Burbia challenge and survive all 20 rounds.
To make it easier, play in the game of a low-level host while using your high-level character.
A safe sniping spot: run to the southwest corner, climb the stairs toward the blue buildings, then climb the three big crates beside the stairs. Enemies cannot reach you there.

achievements.description: Completed the larger challenge in The Angelic Ruins coliseum
achievements.summary: Finish all 20 rounds of the large Angelic Ruins challenge.

guide.context: Each large challenge takes about 2.5 to 5 hours. Enemy level follows the game's host, so playing a high-level character in the game of a low-level host (level 20 or below) makes it far easier.

steps.text: Finish the mission "Prove Yourself" first so the large challenges appear.
Enter the large Angelic Ruins challenge and survive all 20 rounds.
To make it easier, play in the game of a low-level host while using your high-level character.

A loose hiding spot: go to the northern end of the map and take the left walkway up to the lookout near the large Crimson Lance gate. Jump on and off the crate to reach a ledge. Horde Wave enemies cannot hit you there, though others may spawn close by.

achievements.description: Completed the larger challenge in The Gully coliseum
achievements.summary: Finish all 20 rounds of the large Gully challenge.

guide.context: Each large challenge takes about 2.5 to 5 hours. Enemy level follows the game's host, so playing a high-level character in the game of a low-level host (level 20 or below) makes it far easier.

steps.text: Finish the mission "Prove Yourself" first so the large challenges appear.
Enter the large Gully challenge and survive all 20 rounds.
To make it easier, play in the game of a low-level host while using your high-level character.

In most waves, hold out at the highest point near the Portal and hide behind the spotlight cart. In the Horde Wave, run to the lower east end, use a large container to climb onto the mushroom-shaped rock, and shoot the Psychos from there.

achievements.description: Completed each of the larger challenges in all 3 coliseums
achievements.summary: Finish the large challenges in all three Underdome coliseums with one character.

steps.text: Use the same character for all three large challenges.
Finish the large challenge in Hell-Burbia, The Angelic Ruins and The Gully.

achievements.summary: Build the Monster, the new vehicle in The Secret Armory of General Knoxx.

steps.text: In @loc{T-Bone Junction}, collect the vehicle parts for the mission "Boost the Monster".
Bring the parts to @npc{Scooter} and install them in the mission "Greasemonkey".
Digi-struct the Monster so it becomes a permanent vehicle you can summon at vehicle stations.

achievements.summary: Rescue Athena in the Lockdown Palace.

steps.text: During the mission "Prison Break: Try Not to Get Shanked", kill @enemy{Mr. Shank} and take the Crimson Lance Personal Teleporter.
Fight through the third floor of the @loc{Lockdown Palace} to Athena and give her the teleporter.

achievements.summary: Destroy the Lance Depot by finishing the "Loot Larceny" mission.

steps.text: Defeat @enemy{General Knoxx} in the @loc{Crimson Armory}. Corrosive damage works well against his armor.
Use the side entrance of the depot with the code Blue, Yellow, Cyan, Orange, and place the Detonator.
Open chests and grab loot for 3:00, then run to the exit before the timer ends.
Watch the credits. The achievement unlocks when they finish.

achievements.summary: Kill Crawmerax the Invincible.

guide.context: Crawmerax is much tougher than anything else in the game and has far less health on the first playthrough. All of his minions die when he does. A weapon with ammo regeneration helps.

steps.text: Finish the Secret Armory story missions first.

In the Deep Fathoms, go to the Crimson Lance outpost that leads to Road's End. Instead of crossing the light bridge, climb the highway overpass to the north and use the Eridian monolith to enter Crawmerax's Lair for the side mission "You. Will. Die.".
Destroy the critical point on Crawmerax's back first. After that, the other critical points can be shot from the front.
Purple Armored Craw Worms take extra damage from corrosive, red Craw Maggots from shock and melee, and green Craw Worms from incendiary. Crawmerax himself has no weakness.

achievements.description: Killed each of the loot midgets
achievements.summary: Kill each of the 5 loot midgets in The Secret Armory of General Knoxx.

guide.context: Each midget can also spawn at random from lockers, fridges, dumpsters and chests, so you may meet them earlier than listed.

collectibles.name: Meat Popsicle
collectibles.location: @loc{T-Bone Junction}, in the houses under the town
collectibles.method: Go to the house farthest from where you entered. Press the red button right of the chest to unlock the locked door, then open the fridge inside.
collectibles.note: He is Level 61. Jump back onto the broken walkway you dropped from and shoot him from there.

collectibles.name: Truxican Wrestler
collectibles.location: @loc{Lockdown Palace}, long hallway at the entrance
collectibles.method: Open the lockers in the hallway. There are 12, and one always holds him.

collectibles.name: Mini-Steve
collectibles.location: @loc{Lockdown Palace}, garage past the convict Claptrap
collectibles.method: Open the chest next to the orange Runner. He always comes out.

collectibles.name: Dumpster Diver
collectibles.location: @loc{The Ridgeway}, Motorhead's garage
collectibles.method: Kill Motorhead during the mission "Little People, Big Experiments", then open the green dumpster in the far back left corner.

collectibles.name: Crimson Shorty
collectibles.location: @loc{Road's End}, just before the Crimson Armory
collectibles.method: Go to the Crimson Lance Chest directly north of the transition to the Crimson Armory and open it. He always comes out.

achievements.description: Destroyed a Lancer while in a Racer
achievements.summary: Destroy a Lancer while driving a Racer.

steps.text: Meet Moxxi in the mission "You've Got Moxxi: Moxxi's Red Light". The Racer then becomes available at vehicle stations.
Lancers are strong. Wear one down in a Monster first, then retreat to a vehicle station.
Summon a Racer and destroy the Lancer with it.

achievements.summary: Reach level 51.

steps.text: Keep earning XP on the second playthrough until you reach level 51.

achievements.summary: Reach level 61.

guide.context: One playthrough cannot reach level 61. The base game gives almost no XP on the second playthrough, and XP picks up again in The Secret Armory of General Knoxx.

steps.text: Finish the first playthrough, then start the second playthrough.
Keep playing the second playthrough, including The Secret Armory of General Knoxx, until you reach level 61.

achievements.description: Completed all missions in Secret Armory
achievements.summary: Complete all 43 missions in The Secret Armory of General Knoxx.

steps.text: Complete all 15 story missions and 28 side missions, including the Circle of Duty missions and "You. Will. Die.".
Turn in the last mission to unlock the achievement.
Turn in every one of the 43 missions in a single playthrough, ending with "You. Will. Die.".

achievements.description: Paid for a worthless tour of the World's Largest Bullet.
achievements.summary: Pay $8,000,000 for the tour of the World's Largest Bullet.

guide.context: You need $8,000,000 on hand. The money counter stops at $9,999,999 but the game still tracks any extra.

steps.text: In the @loc{Sunken Sea}, during the mission "Code Breaker: Time Is Bullets", go to the World's Largest Bullet.
From the shops, climb the nearby stairs to the small building with flashing yellow arrows pointing at a collection box.
Pay the $8,000,000. There is no actual tour.
To keep your money, quit to the main menu before the game saves. The achievement stays.

achievements.summary: Read all 6 Claptrap statue placards in Claptrap's New Robot Revolution.

collectibles.name: Hyperion Dump placard
collectibles.location: @loc{Hyperion Dump}, down the trail on your left as you enter
collectibles.method: Read the placard. It appears after Claptrap takes over the area during the first operation.

collectibles.name: Sander's Gorge placard
collectibles.location: @loc{Sander's Gorge}, straight ahead as you enter, near the shops
collectibles.method: Read the placard.

collectibles.name: Dividing Faults placard
collectibles.location: @loc{Dividing Faults}, straight ahead as you enter
collectibles.method: Read the placard.

collectibles.name: Scorched Snake Canyon placard
collectibles.location: @loc{Scorched Snake Canyon}, down the stairs left of the Checkpoint
collectibles.method: Walk down the tracks a few steps, turn left toward the Checkpoint, go round the corner, and read the placard.

collectibles.name: Tartarus Station placard
collectibles.location: @loc{Tartarus Station}, northeast of town after the side gates
collectibles.method: Go down the stairs after the gates and read the placard before the canyon to Wayward Pass. This happens during the mission "Operation Trap Claptrap Trap, Phase Four: Reboot".

collectibles.name: Wayward Pass placard
collectibles.location: @loc{Wayward Pass}, center of the path junction outside Knoxx-Trap's arena
collectibles.method: Leave the arena, walk straight ahead and read the placard at the junction.

achievements.summary: Defeat Knoxx-Trap in Wayward Pass.

steps.text: Follow the story to @loc{Wayward Pass} and cross the winding opening area to the large arena.
Fight from behind the large crate at the arena entrance and pop in and out of cover to shoot.
Defeat @enemy{Knoxx-Trap}.

achievements.summary: Defeat Commandant Steele-Trap in the Phase Four: Reboot mission.

steps.text: After Knoxx-Trap and Ned-Trap, defeat @enemy{Commandant Steele-Trap} to finish the mission "Operation Trap Claptrap Trap, Phase Four: Reboot".
Do not let her swords touch you.

achievements.summary: Defeat Dr. Ned-Trap in the Phase Four: Reboot mission.

steps.text: After Knoxx-Trap, defeat @enemy{Dr. Ned-Trap}, who appears in his transformed form.

achievements.description: Killed the Interplanetary Ninja Assassin Claptrap
achievements.summary: Defeat the Interplanetary Ninja Assassin Claptrap.

steps.text: In the @loc{Arid Badlands}, destroy the MINAC tank. Dodge its front laser, since being run over by it kills you.
Kill the @enemy{Interplanetary Ninja Assassin Claptrap}.

achievements.description: Completed a crazy request for Tannis
achievements.summary: Complete Tannis' last Claptrap-Component mission.

guide.context: Components keep dropping after you finish the missions, so farm them while you work on the other Claptrap achievements.

steps.text: Finish the mission "Are You From These Parts?" and talk to @npc{Tannis} at @loc{Tartarus Station}.

Her first request is "Fight For Your Right To Part-E". Keep turning in components as she gives you new requests. The four missions ask for 42, 75, 100 and 150 Claptrap-Components, and the last one is "A Part Of Something Larger Than Yourself".
Claptrap enemies in every area of the DLC drop Claptrap-Components. The factory in Dividing Faults and the northwest end of Hyperion Dump are good spots.

achievements.summary: Collect 25 Off-Shore Oil Cans from Claptrap enemies.

guide.context: Claptrap enemies drop the rare collectibles at random. The MINAC tank in the Arid Badlands keeps sending out Claptraps, which makes it the best place to farm. To fight it again, re-beat the three Wayward Pass bosses. Active farming is faster than idling.

steps.text: Kill Claptrap enemies and pick up the @item{Off-Shore Oil Cans} they drop until you have 25.

achievements.summary: Collect 15 Claptrap Bobbleheads from Claptrap enemies.

guide.context: Claptrap enemies drop the rare collectibles at random. The MINAC tank in the Arid Badlands keeps sending out Claptraps, which makes it the best place to farm. To fight it again, re-beat the three Wayward Pass bosses. Active farming is faster than idling.

steps.text: Kill Claptrap enemies and pick up the @item{Claptrap Bobbleheads} they drop until you have 15.
Bobbleheads and Pizzas are the rarest drops, so this may be one of the last ones you finish.

steps.text: Kill Claptrap enemies and pick up the @item{3D Glasses} they drop until you have 5.

achievements.description: Collect 3 Pink Panties, 5 Clap-Fish and 15 Pizzas.

steps.text: Kill Claptrap enemies and pick up 3 @item{Pink Panties}, 5 @item{Clap-Fish} and 15 @item{Pizzas}.
